Name: Aggressive Farm Monsters
Author: CrimsonRevolver24
Description:
[size=5]Aggressive Farm Monsters
[/size]
[b]Do you feel like the monster spawn toggle or the Wilderness Farm's feature of "having monsters" is too simple or hate having to wait until night? Would you prefer to start fighting monsters as soon as you step out into your farm?[/b]

Traditional farm monster spawning seemed like a gimmick to me. This mod transforms that into a core gameplay mechanic, letting you battle it out during daytime, and including the option to get seasonal rewards that actually help your farm progress since you'll be spending a bit more time swinging your sword instead of plowing and watering.

[color=#ffff00][size=4][b]New in 1.2.1 (Feb 24 2026)[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Added Wave spawn logic and options. This lets you choose a fixed number of monsters that will spawn every X minutes or hours, as you choose. There's also now a hotkey keyboard button option for manually spawning a wave.  
[*]Added logic to remove leftover monsters when sleeping or when defeated in the farm. 
[*]Minor fixes to Aggressive Mode and Brutal Mode. Brutal Mode should be a little bit more fair now.
[/list]
[size=4]Key Features
[/size][list]
[*][size=2][b]Fully Configurable[/b]: Using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][b]﻿, [/b]you can tweak spawn multipliers, max monster limits, and toggle features on the fly.[/size]
[*][size=2][b]Daytime Spawning:[/b] Monsters no longer wait for the sun to go down. Configure your own start times and spawn rates.[/size]
[*][size=2][b]Seasonal Loot Table:[/b] If enabled, every monster killed on the farm has a chance to drop farm resources based on the current season (Carrot seeds in Spring, Powdermelons in Winter, etc.) and it comes from a modifiable JSON file included in the mod so you can add, edit or remove as you see fit.[/size]
[*][size=2][b]Starting Sword:[/b] You can choose to start a new file with a Rusty Sword on day 1 so you aren't defenseless against the early-game spawns.[/size]
[*] [size=2][b]Aggressive Mode:[/b] Toggleable setting to make monsters lock onto the player immediately upon spawning, forcing you to fight.[/size]
[*][size=2][b]Brutal Mode[/b]: Harder enemies, unfair fights and crazy spawn rates.[/size]
[*][size=2][b]Swarms[/b]: Like in the mines, you can get a swarm event that sends a lot of monsters your way.[/size]
[*][size=2][b]Blood Moon: [/b]Check what the fortune teller has to say, for you may have to prepare once the sun goes down.[/size]
[/list]
[size=4]Installation[/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.[/size]
[*][size=2]Download this mod and unzip it into your [i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i] folder.[/size]
[*][size=2](Optional) Install [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] to change settings in-game.[/size]
[*][size=2]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size]
[/list][size=2]
[/size][size=4]Loot Customization[/size]
[size=2]You can customize the loot drops by editing the [i]loot.json[/i] file included in the mod folder even before the first run. Add your own items, change drop chances, or adjust seasonal availability as you see fit. The parameters used for this JSON file are:
[list]
[*][size=2]ItemID: Uses the internal item ID value. You can use[url=https://mateusaquino.github.io/stardewids/] Mateus Aquino's tool[/url]﻿ to check the IDs you want to add.[/size]
[*][size=2]Chance: A value between 0.0 to 1.0, with 0 being impossible to drop and 1 meaning it always drops[/size]
[*][size=2]MinQuantity and MaxQuantity: How many items you can get each time the specific item is rolled[/size]
[*][size=2]Season: You can choose which season it needs to be for the item to drop. "Spring", "Summer", "Fall", "Winter" and "All" are the available options (not case sensitive).[/size]
[/list]
[/size][size=4]Coming later...[/size]
[list]
[*]Monster Swarms (Mine-like events) ✅
[*]Monster Weather System (Get specific monsters spawning on certain days)
[*]Blood Moons (Some nights will make monsters stronger and spawn in hordes, with better loot) ✅
[*]Adhoc monster spawns by date or season (Haunted skulls on Spirits Eve, blue slimes during winter)
[/list]
